devops.summary: As a part of a team ensuring 24/7/365 service availability, I provided third-tier support to a LAMP stack shared hosting platform with over 500 physical nodes. My key responsibilities included:
highlights: Designed, planned, installed, configured, administered, and tuned applications, database, and web servers across hundreds of nodes.
Developed **monitoring** and **alerting systems** to proactively manage **infrastructure health** and stability, maintaining **99.9% uptime**.
Created a management and deployment system for 30+ KVM/Xen hypervisors, along with an internal control panel.
Developed the dedicated server management panel, dedikit.net, to enhance user experience and functionality.
Participated in 3 major migrations between data centers and implemented solutions to mitigate **DDoS attacks** and **security breaches**.
Collaborated closely with upstream providers and data center staff through tickets and abuse boards, keeping abuse processing time at a **consistently low level**.
Remotely configured active **L2/L3 network equipment**, including **Cisco** 29xx/35xx switches and routers.
Assisted thousands of customers through email, ICQ, Jabber, and control panel ticketing systems, providing support and guidance.
**Mentored junior administrators**, managing their onboarding process and conducting technical training sessions.
